edges.subject: PSENEN
edges.quote: Mutations in components of the γ-secretase underlie familial Alzheimer disease.

edges.subject: CLN3
edges.quote: Mutations in CLN3 are causative for juvenile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, a rare lysosomal storage disorder considered the most common neurodegenerative disease in children.

edges.subject: PSENEN
edges.quote: We observed in PSENEN- and CLN3-knockout cells corresponding alterations in the autophagy-lysosome system.
